markdownFonts.scope: Four independent/one-sided preference pairs, two themes and native 100/150% zoom per window; paragraph and heading inline code, actual table and code surfaces, defaults reset, saved original text and preferences restored. Product retains a 480px code scroll limit, semantic inline code and independent window implementations. Other OS/DPI, source runtime defaults, decorated mention branches and all special writing/preview/hover variants remain unverified.

inlineTheme.pixelBoundary: Computed CSS background painted into an uncomposited 1px canvas; 8-bit premultiplication permits RGB tolerance 10 for hover and 6 for inline. This is not a measurement of every screenshot pixel or actual source glyph face.

focusedInlineVisualReview.scope: All 32 focused inline captures were individually displayed. High zoom and narrow windows show scrolling slices, sometimes only a bold line or the top of a code surface. This does not prove simultaneous visibility of all content, every heading state, reference runtime glyph selection, other DPI or complete page parity.

failedObservation.cause: Initial hover sample preceded the existing 150ms CSS transition. Retry waits for actual hover and no running animation; final color assertions and the original timeout remain unchanged.

intermediateFocusedScope: Product inputs and all compiled files match the final type/build/unit/coverage receipts. After those checks, only native clipboard error formatting gained compact first-difference diagnostics; the final full native run freezes and executes that observer. Failed native evidence is retained separately.

priorFullRecorderFailure.reason: Post-run Git diff exceeded the external recorder buffer. Failed recording and native observations retained; final rerun writes launch and child-exit checkpoints before post-processing and uses a 64MiB diff buffer. Product inputs, original test deadlines and storage guards are unchanged.

priorClipboardFailure.scope: Initial native ClipboardItem round-trip/restoration deep equality failed before the table-copy write. Safe MIME/hash diagnostic labels were added without changing the comparisons or restoration. The same physical-clipboard focused main run then passed; no unverified root cause is claimed.

priorCoverageFailure.scope: Worktree retention/removal test exceeded its original 5000ms limit; teardown then encountered EBUSY. Full coverage was rerun alone after build and desktop phases ended. No test, timeout or coverage configuration was changed; the initiating cause of the slow operation is not established.

priorClipboardRestorationFailure.scope: The previous full diagnostic was cut by the unchanged 300-character main-process error boundary. Only the message format was compacted to show the first differing MIME and hash prefixes; full byte comparisons and restoration were retained. A subsequent focused main run passed; this does not establish the initiating cause.
